question: What is the sentiment of the news article titled 'Microsoft and NVIDIA announce major AI infrastructure partnership'?
cypher: MATCH (n:NewsArticle {title: 'Microsoft and NVIDIA announce major AI infrastructure partnership'}) RETURN n.sentiment LIMIT 10

question: What sector does the company supplying components to Tesla Inc. belong to?
Which company competes with Microsoft Corp. and is indirectly connected to Pfizer Inc. through a service usage relationship?
Which sector does the company led by Elon Musk belong to?
What is the title and sentiment of the news article mentioning Microsoft Corp., where Satya Nadella is the CEO?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person {name: 'Satya Nadella'})-[:CEO_OF]->(c:Company {ticker: 'MSFT'})-[:MENTIONED_IN]->(n:NewsArticle) RETURN n.title, n.sentiment LIMIT 10
ground_truth: BlackRock increases stake in AI-driven companies, positive; Microsoft and NVIDIA announce major AI infrastructure partnership, positive
answer: Microsoft and NVIDIA announce major AI infrastructure partnership, positive

question: What is the sentiment and date of the news article mentioning the company led by Satya Nadella?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person {name: 'Satya Nadella'})-[:CEO_OF]->(c:Company)-[:MENTIONED_IN]->(n:NewsArticle) WHERE n.title = 'BlackRock increases stake in AI-driven companies' RETURN n.sentiment, n.date LIMIT 10

question: What is the title and sentiment of the news article mentioning the company that Microsoft partners with, given that Satya Nadella is the CEO of Microsoft?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person {name: 'Satya Nadella'})-[:CEO_OF]->(c1:Company {ticker: 'MSFT'})-[:PARTNERS_WITH]->(c2:Company)-[:MENTIONED_IN]->(n:NewsArticle) RETURN n.title, n.sentiment LIMIT 10
ground_truth: BlackRock increases stake in AI-driven companies, positive; JPMorgan integrates advanced AI models into institutional trading, positive; Microsoft and NVIDIA announce major AI infrastructure partnership, positive
answer:
Title: Microsoft and NVIDIA announce major AI infrastructure partnership  
Sentiment: positive

question: Which company does a firm that Vanguard Group has invested in use as a service provider, and that service provider has a partnership with another company?

answer:
Title: Microsoft and NVIDIA announce major AI infrastructure partnership

question: What is the average market capitalization of companies in the Technology sector, ranked by their market cap in descending order, limited to the top 5 companies?
cypher: MATCH (c:Company)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(s:Sector {name: 'Technology'}) RETURN avg(c.market_cap_bln) AS average_market_cap LIMIT 10
